title: Why United Airlines is blocking personal AI agents
description: United announced it is restricting unauthorized third-party AI agents from its app and website. Here's what an AI agent is and why airlines worry.

scenes.say: United Airlines announced it's blocking unauthorized third-party AI agents from its app and website.
First, what's an AI agent? A chatbot answers questions. An agent goes further. It can use websites and apps to carry out tasks for you, like booking a flight.

steps: It logs in on your behalf
scenes.say: To do that, it needs access. You give it a goal, it logs in as you, clicks through the pages, and pays. Afterward, you review what it did.

United named three concerns. Sharing your login with a third party. An agent buying things or redeeming miles you didn't intend. And rules like check-in, where a person must confirm what's in their bags.

scenes.sub: who's allowed to act as you
scenes.say: United says it will review the policy as AI assistants evolve. The bigger question is who gets to click for you. Follow if you want AI explained without the jargon.
